typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ADFId__c as string,
		Id as string,
		Notes__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/contact_update_Contact_Notes.csv']) ~> notesContact
source(output(
		ADFId__c as string,
		Id as string,
		Notes__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/contact_update_Lead_Notes.csv']) ~> notesLead
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		Notes__c,
		Contact__c = Id,
		Notes_Type__c,
		SObject_Name__c,
		Name
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
DerivedColumn2 select(mapColumn(
		Notes__c,
		Lead__c = Id,
		Notes_Type__c,
		SObject_Name__c,
		Name
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select2
notesContact derive(Notes_Type__c = 'Member',
		SObject_Name__c = 'Contact',
		Name = concat(toString(currentUTC(), 'MM/dd/yyyy:HH:mm'), '_Member')) ~> DerivedColumn1
notesLead derive(Notes_Type__c = 'Medicare',
		SObject_Name__c = 'Lead',
		Name = concat(toString(currentUTC(), 'MM/dd/yyyy:HH:mm'), '_Medicare')) ~> DerivedColumn2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['contact_update_Contact_Notes__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertContactNotes
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['contact_update_Lead_Notes__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertLeadNotes
